selected_evidence.requirement: Identify shared segment topology (node2/node3 attached to node1's segment)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed node1 eth1 / node2 enp8s0 / node3 enp8s0 are on one flat L2 segment; direct link-local ping from node2 to node3 succeeded, proving they can reach each other without transiting node1.
Static IPs configured: node1 eth1=192.168.50.1/24 (interfaces.d file), node2 enp8s0=192.168.50.11/24 and node3 enp8s0=192.168.50.12/24 (NetworkManager static profiles).
Pre-isolation ping tests show node2<->node1, node2<->node3, node3<->node1 all succeed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Port isolation: node2 and node3 cannot exchange traffic directly
selected_evidence.summary: firewalld permanent rich rules added (node2 drops src 192.168.50.12, node3 drops src 192.168.50.11); post-change ping shows node2->node3 and node3->node2 100% loss.

selected_evidence.requirement: Both node2 and node3 continue to reach node1
selected_evidence.summary: node2->node1 and node3->node1 ping succeed after isolation rules applied; node1->node2 and node1->node3 also succeed, confirming node1 is unaffected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e5a08f0f captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; connection reset/timeout observed during reboot; post-reboot boot_id 7ef81ccb (changed) with uptime ~10s; eth1 IP and SONiC docker containers confirmed healthy; ping to node2 and node3 succeeded post-reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state including firewall persistence
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d340bf4 and firewalld rule captured; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id b03f1481 (changed, uptime ~10s); static IP and firewalld rich-rule confirmed persisted; ping to node1 succeeds, ping to node3 still blocked.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node3 restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state including firewall persistence
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id deef5424 and firewalld rule captured; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id 396a0757 (changed, uptime ~5s); static IP and firewalld rich-rule confirmed persisted; ping to node1 succeeds, ping to node2 still blocked.
